notes.title: Alpha starts today at 4:30 PM! (UTC+2)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Time to get your decks ready — the battle’s about to begin!

After several months of development and private playtesting, we’re excited to announce that Mixcity Swap’s servers will open today at 4:30 PM (UTC+2) and stay live until Sunday, June 29 at 11:59 PM (UTC+2).
[hr][/hr]

When can you play?
The game will be available to download on Steam starting at 2:00 PM.

Servers go live at 4:30 PM, and you’ll be able to jump in, play your first matches, and explore everything this version has to offer!
[hr][/hr]

Quick FAQ
What languages are available?
The interface and all text are fully available in English and French.
Voice acting is English-only for now.

Is the game paid?
Nope. Mixcity Swap is free-to-play, and this version is an alpha — no purchases, no microtransactions, nothing to spend. Just testing and fun!

Will my progress be saved?
Yes! Your decks, unlocked cards, and rewards will carry over between playtest sessions.
The only exception: global ranking and leaderboard will be reset each time.
[hr][/hr]

What’s new in this version?
All changes and new features were explained in detail in our previous news post — but here’s a quick summary:

Brand new UI/UX overhaul

Custom game mode

Ranking system is here

Soft currency shop integration

Account leveling system

More Augment choices during Time OUT

Complete visual & audio rework
[hr][/hr]

Bug? Question? Issue?
We’ve got you covered.
The best way to reach us is through our Discord server

You can report bugs, ask questions, or just hang out with the community and dev team.
[hr][/hr]


We can’t wait to see you in-game, read your feedback, and keep building this game with you.
Thanks for your amazing support — and see you soon on Mixcity Swap! 💥



— The ATYPIQUE Studio team

notes.title: Mixcity Swap | Playtests open on June 17
notes.content:
After several months of prototyping and numerous playtests, we are delighted to unveil the first Alpha version of Mixcity Swap, which marks a major step in the evolution of the game.

Available for playtesting from June 17, this version incorporates a large number of visual, functional and content improvements, designed to enhance the immersion, clarity and strategic depth of the game experience.

Major new features include

 An all-new UI/UX interface, more readable, more dynamic, and entirely redesigned to reflect the competitive and sporting world of Mixcity Swap.
 A “personalized” game mode to enable private confrontations, ideal for community tournaments or training sessions.
 Ranking inspired by judo belts, with a global leaderboard to track your performance and that of other players.
 The integration of a soft currency store, allowing you to obtain your cards as you play.
 An account leveling system with rewards for each level reached (cards, currency, titles...).
 Expanded Augment options during Time OUT, as well as new tactical maps, to enrich game diversity and encourage strategic adaptation.
 A complete graphic and sound overhaul: map redesign, unified illustrations, new in-game animations and rethought sound effects for greater dynamism and impact.


These new features represent an important step towards opening up the game to a wider audience, and we look forward to gathering your feedback as we continue to move Mixcity Swap in the right direction. 

If you haven't already done so, you can join our Discord to keep up to date with the game and chat with the team: discord.gg/mixcity

See you soon on Mixcity Swap.
